I am a Postdoctoral Researcher at the University of Bristol. I develop software tools for automated CAD generation, FEA simulation and topology optimisation of adaptive aircraft structures. I have a keen interest in Computational Mechanics and Machine Learning. I will be writing about my hobby projects in this blog.
